product_risk_or_requirement: Unsupported or source-contradicted factual claims can pass through a fluent script and be published
current_state: Source cards and a no-auto-publish boundary are specified, but no export-gate test or measured factual-support performance exists.
product_requirement: Every factual sentence must have an accessible supporting passage or an explicit uncertainty state; unresolved or contradicted factual sentences must prevent export.
acceptance_criteria: Given a seeded draft containing an unsupported and a source-contradicted factual sentence When a creator requests export Then export is stopped, both sentences and candidate passages are displayed, and only an editor's evidenced support decision or removal can clear the gate with an audit record.
deadline_or_trigger: Before the first invited creator can export a draft
evidence_needed: Independent test report on a frozen 300-claim Vietnamese benchmark, export-gate demonstration, reviewer records, and zero unresolved high-impact claims

product_risk_or_requirement: Generated passages may reproduce earlier expression without attribution and create credit, dispute or copyright risk
current_state: Public references are displayed and private or paywalled inputs are excluded, but the similarity threshold, approved corpus and override evidence are not validated.
product_requirement: High-similarity passages must be reviewed side by side and cannot be exported until attributed, substantially rewritten or removed; the system must retain the decision evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Given a benchmark containing verbatim, close-paraphrase and common-phrase examples When similarity review runs before export Then every seeded verbatim or close-paraphrase case is blocked for side-by-side review, common phrases remain reviewable, and an export occurs only after attribution, rewrite or removal is recorded.
evidence_needed: Threshold calibration report with false-positive and false-negative counts, 500-example adversarial test, audit-log sample, and Legal sign-off on attribution UX

product_risk_or_requirement: High-volume script generation can externalize screening cost and close opportunities for legitimate writers
current_state: The pilot is invitation-only and has no publisher integration, but the burst threshold, account-link response and abuse appeal are not acceptance-tested.
product_requirement: The product must keep submission automation unavailable, limit burst generation and export, suspend coordinated abuse, and provide a documented independent appeal.
acceptance_criteria: Given an account reaches 11 complete-script exports in a rolling 24-hour window or requests a prohibited external-submission bypass When another full-script export is attempted Then the export is frozen, Trust and Safety receives linked evidence, no external submission is sent, and the creator receives a route to an appeal handled by a different operator.
deadline_or_trigger: Before full-script export is enabled for any pilot account
evidence_needed: Rate-limit and integration test logs, coordinated-account tabletop, abuse policy, operator runbook, and appeal separation record

product_risk_or_requirement: A user can request deceptive imitation or false authorship using a living person's name
current_state: Terms prohibit impersonation and no publishing connector exists, but named-person safeguards and the 24-hour complaint path are not demonstrated.
product_requirement: The product must refuse false-authorship and deceptive living-person imitation, preserve provenance, and contain a verified complaint within 24 hours with appeal and Legal escalation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a prompt that assigns a living author as the author of generated text or a verified complaint about an exported draft When generation, export or complaint intake occurs Then deceptive authorship is refused or the export is revoked, linked accounts are contained within 24 hours, evidence is preserved, and any appeal is reviewed by a separate operator.
deadline_or_trigger: Before creator export and continuously after launch
evidence_needed: Named-person red-team results, provenance demonstration, complaint service-level drill, notification templates, and separated appeal log

product_risk_or_requirement: Vietnam actor role, risk category and AI notice or output-identification duties must be confirmed independently
current_state: The scoped system appears to support narrow human work optimization and directly interacts with users, but no signed Vietnamese legal analysis has mapped Articles 41 to 45 or checked the current ministerial product list.
product_requirement: A Vietnamese legal reviewer must classify the frozen use case, map developer, provider and deployer duties, approve AI-interaction notice and output marking, and document data, consumer and intellectual-property conditions.
acceptance_criteria: Given the frozen Vietnam use case, data flow, vendor contracts and launch build When qualified Vietnamese counsel reviews the law and implementing instruments current on the review date Then a signed memo states the classification and each applicable duty, the tested UX satisfies notice and marking requirements, and no critical legal question remains unowned.
deadline_or_trigger: Before any external pilot use in Vietnam
evidence_needed: Signed dated legal memo, current-law search log, role and obligation matrix, AI-notice screenshots, output-identification test, and unresolved-issue register

product_risk_or_requirement: EU provider and deployer roles and Article 50 transparency duties apply independently of the Vietnam analysis
current_state: Article 50 applies from 2 August 2026 and the product generates text, but provider role, machine-readable marking, public-interest text handling and any transitional treatment are not approved for this architecture.
product_requirement: EU access must remain disabled until counsel confirms classification and roles and tests prove direct-interaction notice, detectable output marking, and a rule for public-interest text and editorial responsibility.
acceptance_criteria: Given the frozen EU architecture, vendor role, intended uses and build date When independent EU counsel applies the current AI Act and Commission guidance Then the memo confirms or changes the provisional limited-transparency classification, assigns each Article 50 duty, and the required notice, machine-readable mark and public-interest editorial-control tests all pass before EU access opens.
deadline_or_trigger: Before enabling an EU pilot user or using output in the EU
evidence_needed: Signed EU classification and role memo, vendor evidence, Article 50 test report, public-interest editorial-responsibility workflow, and market-access control demonstration

product_risk_or_requirement: Human review can become a rubber stamp when reviewers lack time, source context, authority or accountability
current_state: The design names creator and editor roles, but no staffing study, competency check or override-quality evidence exists.
product_requirement: Every public-interest claim and every control override must receive time-bounded review by a trained editor with source context, explicit editorial responsibility and authority to reject or stop export.
acceptance_criteria: Given a draft with a public-interest claim or requested control override When the creator asks to export Then a trained editor receives the source passage and uncertainty evidence, records accept, edit or reject with a reason, is able to stop export, and the system blocks completion if reviewer identity, elapsed review time or editorial responsibility is missing.
evidence_needed: Reviewer training record, workload simulation at peak pilot volume, 50-case decision-quality audit, override sample, and export-block demonstration

product_risk_or_requirement: Risk metrics may breach without a timely pause, investigation and affected-output review
current_state: Owners and thresholds are proposed in the harm map, but alert routing, pause authority, rollback evidence and incident rehearsal are absent.
product_requirement: Each KRI and guardrail breach must create an owned incident, pause the affected capability within one hour, identify outputs since the last passing check and require independent approval to resume.
acceptance_criteria: Given a simulated unsupported-claim, near-copy, bulk-export or impersonation threshold breach When monitoring evaluates the event Then an incident is assigned within 15 minutes, the affected export path pauses within 60 minutes, impacted drafts are listed, creators are notified where needed, and an independent reviewer records evidence before resumption.
deadline_or_trigger: Before the pilot release review and after any material model or vendor change
evidence_needed: End-to-end alert and rollback drill, timestamps proving service levels, impacted-output inventory, communication sample, and independent resumption approval
